rules.body: Apply when deferred edits belong to a persistent document buffer while its view subscription has a shorter lifetime. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription."

Replace the pending text and restart the quiet interval on each edit; after the interval, save only the latest text and keep later bursts usable. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/workflow.go: "if t.handle!=nil { t.env.Cancel(t.handle) };t.pending=&text;t.handle=t.env.Schedule(t.Flush,t.delay)"

Keep pending persistence associated with the originating document and owned by BufferBank across badge detachment. Do not infer that removing a subscription discards its document's pending save. docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." src/workflow.go: "b.entries[id]=NewTrailing(env,120,func(text string){env.Write(id,text)})"

Clear a trailing task's pending state before invoking its work so synchronous callbacks can establish new pending work without the outer flush clearing it afterward. src/workflow.go: "text:=t.pending;t.handle=nil;t.pending=nil" followed by "if text!=nil { t.work(*text) }"

Treat synchronous save notifications as possible navigation boundaries. If navigation invokes a save, revalidate the navigation request after that callback returns before installing an outer destination. docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." src/workflow.go: "request:=w.generation" and "if true&&request!=w.generation{return}"

Preserve interfaces, identities, text, and status semantics; retain the preview's separate cancellation policy and interval. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces.\nThe adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." src/workflow.go: "func(p *Preview)Hide(){p.task.Cancel()}"

Exclude transient discard-on-hide work from the persistent-buffer ownership rule. README.md: "Preview is transient and owns a different quiet interval." This distinction does not authorize changing preview behavior.

Verify no burst write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write afterward, and successful later bursts, including empty text. Exercise switching, closing, and same-document reopening to check identity and persistence; exercise synchronous save listeners that navigate or enqueue another edit to check reentry. These checks derive from TASK: "write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." and docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." Do not impose immediate departure flushing without additional normative evidence.

limitations: The task and behavioral documentation establish persistence across badge departure, but do not specify whether departure must flush immediately or allow the pending timer to finish.
Evaluation observations do not establish requirements. A passing candidate does not prove causality, exhaustive correctness, or benefit on another task.
The supplied subscription/decode experience concerns a different mechanism and supplies no additional obligations here.
The supplied code does not establish behavior for callbacks delivered after timer cancellation or for synchronous execution inside Schedule.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
